protocol.source: AI4Mars 0.6 Curiosity NAV ground photos; crowd-consensus labels
protocol.sampling: 640 train frames including old usable frames and up to 80 new big-rock frames; 96 validation frames including up to 32 big-rock frames; 128 random eligible test frames; up to 64 separate rock-challenge frames
protocol.split: 100000-second acquisition bins: every official expert bin excluded; every original fitting bin assigned to fit; other bins hash modulo10: 0=test, 1/2=validation, 3..9=fit. Test/challenge may share bins, neither may overlap fitting/validation.

head.initialization: published v1 head on frozen ImageNet features

protocol.selection: Highest supported-class balanced validation accuracy, then overall accuracy. Keep earliest tied epoch; prefer head on candidate tie. Do not refit on validation.
protocol.promotion: Fresh random-test gain >=1 percentage point with positive paired-bin bootstrap 95% lower bound, balanced accuracy no worse, no supported-class recall loss >5 points; each historical expert accuracy loses <=1 point; challenge big-rock recall no worse with >=20 big-rock crops from >=5 bins; fresh random test covers all four classes.
protocol.test_use: Only selected candidate and published baseline are evaluated after selection is saved. No test-driven retries.
protocol.limitations: Ground-view majority crop classification; crowd labels and bin separation are not expert validation, exact-site registration, aerial validation, physical independence or navigation safety.
